sample.composition: main A · under 50% B · inactive C · no lessons D — {a} · {b} · {c} · {d}
sample.included: Attendance is at least 50% of checked lessons since enrollment.
sample.excluded_b: Attendance is below 50% of checked lessons since enrollment.
sample.excluded_c: Inactive pupil — excluded from group averages.
sample.excluded_d: No checked lessons after enrollment — attendance cannot be calculated.

pupil.lessons_empty: No checked lessons in this period.
pupil.dynamics_hint: Normalized lesson score (% of that lesson’s maximum), 3-lesson moving average, trend — slope over the last 6 lessons.
pupil.dynamics_delta_aria: Change in moving average from lesson to lesson
pupil.dynamics_insufficient_points: At least four lessons with scores are needed for a trend.

chart.insufficient_data: More checked lessons are needed in the selected period.

tables.birth_year_note: Main sample only; small groups are indicative.

empty.no_pupils_description: Add pupils to the group to see analytics.
empty.no_checked_lessons: There are no checked lessons in the selected period yet.

conducted.title: Who led which lessons
conducted.subtitle: Lead teacher may differ from the checker.

methodology.title: How we calculated
methodology.body: Group averages and charts use the main sample only (≥50% attendance since enrollment). NULL means not graded; 0 counts. Late submission counts as submitted.
methodology.attendance: Share of the main sample present on each checked lesson.
methodology.verses: Average verses recited; review and first regular lesson have no point.
methodology.test: Average score 0–10; lessons without a test have no point.
methodology.notebook: Average notebook score 0–10 for the main sample.

deleted_data.title: Deleted data
deleted_data.note: Metrics were recalculated after a guardian data deletion request on {date}.
deleted_data.note_with_count: Metrics were recalculated after a guardian data deletion request on {date}. Children affected: {count}.

rating.privacy_note: Visible to teachers and administrators only. Not shown to parents or pupils and not for display mode.
rating.footnote: Place is by lesson points for the year. Achievements and penalties are not included in place (penalties post-MVP).

school.groups_table_hint: Pupils: main sample / total. Averages use the main sample.
school.attendance_chart_hint: Share present in the main sample, %.
school.attention_pending_hint: Registered and consented to data processing
school.attention_negative_bricks_hint: Scores were corrected after bricks were issued
school.no_group_in_year: This group did not exist this year
school.closed_composition_note: Groups are compared only within the selected year. Group membership differs across years.

years.title: Totals by year
years.composition_note: Annual totals for the main sample. A row opens that year. Different pupils may have been in the group in different years — this compares cohorts, not the same children.
years.none: The school year has not started yet
years.readonly_note: Closed year — read-only. Totals were fixed when the year was closed.
years.methodology_note: This year uses methodology {snapshotVersion}; current methodology is {currentVersion}. Closed-year totals are not recalculated.
years.snapshot_missing: No snapshot totals for this year
years.sample_meta: Pupils in main sample: {kids} · lessons checked: {lessons}

pupil_years.title: By year
pupil_years.foreign_group_note: Years in other teachers' groups are shown as this pupil's totals; you cannot open those groups' analytics.
pupil_years.chart_note: One axis — years; each point is an annual total. Lessons from different years are not combined on one axis.
